decisions.reason: Conferencing saw a pandemic-driven demand boost that lets management attribute weak results to temporary market conditions, so it persists despite low strategic centrality and rising competition from cloud collaboration tools.
The metro data centre network rests on heavy owned-fibre investment, has publicly reported adoption, and is central to the announced data centre and cloud direction, so commitment is very strong.
The number ordering portal is a low-cost software platform aligned with the real-time provisioning direction, so there is little reason to withdraw it.

Carrier pre-selection is a declining legacy service with little strategic fit, but its regulatory ties, existing customer base and low running cost lead management to keep it a while longer rather than admit the launch was misjudged.
Direct voice network connection builds on sunk voice infrastructure investment and serves enterprise customers moving to cloud voice, so the firm persists with it.
